description: Generate a carousel PDF for a LinkedIn (or other) post from the post's cards. Returns an asset ID and download URL for the PDF. Requires cards to be set first via set_post_cards or edit_post_card — the carousel's actual page content always comes from those rendered card assets, never from postContent. postContent does NOT change what appears in the carousel. It's only a fallback used to build a readable output filename when title is omitted: the first ~5 words become a slugified filename (e.g. "my-launch-post-is-here.pdf"). Pass title when you want control over the filename; postContent is a same-value convenience (e.g. the post's own content) for callers that don't have a title handy.

postContent.description: Fallback source for the output filename when title is omitted (e.g. pass the post's content). Purely cosmetic — has no effect on the carousel's pages, which always come from the post's rendered cards.

title.description: Carousel title override — used to build the output filename. Takes priority over postContent.

name: generate_post_carousel
